definitions.explanation: The height of power, wealth and magnificence enjoyed by a person, family or city. A literary word, often used with the sense that such glory does not last.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一族|いちぞく}→一族：11229_ichizoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{栄華|えいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}めた→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧。
examples.english: The clan reached the height of its glory.

examples.japanese: {平家|へいけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{栄華|えいが}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{続|つづ}かなかった→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The glory of the Taira clan did not last long.

examples.japanese: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧{栄華|えいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誇|ほこ}った→誇る：14180_hokoru⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な{田舎町|いなかまち}になっている。
examples.english: This town, which once boasted great splendor, is now a quiet country town.

notes:
A written, literary word. It often appears in reflections on how wealth and power pass away.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {栄華|えいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}める→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧: to reach the height of glory
- {栄華|えいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誇|ほこ}る→誇る：14180_hokoru⟧: to boast great splendor
- {栄華|えいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{夢見|ゆめみ}る→夢見る：10543_yumemiru⟧: to dream of glory and riches
- {栄耀栄華|えいようえいが}: luxury and splendor (a set four-character phrase)

WATCH OUT:
Same reading as the everyday ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧ (movie); context always tells them apart.
